PURCHASE YOUR TICKET

To purchase a 5 In-A-Line ticket, go to a vending machine or any counter where Lottery is sold to ask the clerk for a ticket.

How to Choose Your Numbers:

This game is Quick Pick only. Five numbers, each from zero to nine, will be randomly generated for you.

Each play costs $1 and gives you a chance to win up to $5,000*!

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings, and you also have the option to choose an add-on to increase your prize.

Then, your ticket will print with your Quick Pick numbers on it.

 

INCREASE YOUR PRIZES WITH SUPER BONUS

When you play 5 In-A-Line you can add on Super Bonus for $1 per play.

Adding Super Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your prize by 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, or 5X. At the very end of the drawing, a multiplier will be selected and will apply to any 5 In-A-Line prize you win in that drawing.

 

HOW TO WIN

During each hourly drawing**, five winning numbers*** will be selected. Match 1 to 5 numbers in the exact drawn order sequence to the drawn 5-digit number to win.

 

HOW TO CHECK WINNING NUMBERS

You can watch the hourly drawings on the Players Club app or online at ArizonaLottery.com.

 

ABOUT WINNING
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

5 IN-A-LINE FAQS
WHAT ARE THE ODDS OF WINNING 5 IN-A-LINE

Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 10.

WHEN ARE 5 IN-A-LINE DRAWINGS HELD?

Drawings are held daily every 60 minutes. The first draw of the day is at 4:30 AM Arizona time and the last draw is at 11:30 PM Arizona time.

HOW OFTEN CAN I PLAY MY NUMBERS?

You can play for up to 15 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or select the Multi Draw box on the vending machine.

HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO CLAIM A 5-IN-A-LINE PRIZE?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

WHAT HAPPENS IF MULTIPLE PEOPLE WIN THE MAXIMUM PRIZE?

The players will share the prize in equal amounts.*

WHERE DO I FIND THE DRAW ID?

Draw IDs appear on each Quick Draw ticket purchased in the bottom right-hand corner. If you purchased a ticket for more than one drawing, a range of Draw IDs will be included on the ticket. For Example: DRAW ID 10001 or, DRAW ID 10001 THRU DRAW ID 10015

 

DISCLAIMERS

*Prizes will be pari-mutuel when the total prize for matching 5/5 with 5X multiplier drawn is above $25,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

**5-in-a-Line can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:30 AM Arizona time. Players have until 11:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase 5-in-a-Line tickets. The last drawing for 5-in-a-Line will be at 11:30 PM Arizona time.

To choose your own numbers, select your numbers on the vending machine or tell the cashier which numbers you would like to select. There are no play slips for Quick Draw games.

Select up to five numbers from one to forty-five (1 - 45). In 5/10/45, these numbers are called spots. The more spots you play, the more chances you have to win.

Then select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play.

A 5-spot wager of $1 gives you a chance to win up to $500 and a $20 wager gives you a chance to win up to $10,000!

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings, and you can choose from one of two add-ons that increase your prize.

Then, your ticket will print with your numbers on it.

When you play 5/10/45 you can choose from one of two add-ons to increase your prizes.

Bullseye gives you a chance to increase your prize. After the drawing, one of the ten winning numbers will be designated as the Bullseye. If you have a winning combination with Bullseye, you win even more! Choosing Bullseye will double the cost of your ticket. For example, if you place a $1 wager and add Bullseye, the cost a total of $2 ($1 Base Play + $1 Bullseye).
Adding Super Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your prize by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 10X, 12X and 20X. At the very end of the drawing, a multiplier will be selected and will apply to any 5/10/45 prize you win in that drawing. Choosing the Super Bonus add-on will triple the cost of your ticket. For example, if you place a $1 wager and choose Super Bonus, the cost will be a total of $3 ($1 Base Play + $2 Super Bonus).

During the hourly drawing, ten winning numbers will be selected.**** There’s a wide variety of ways to win by matching a combination of these numbers!

To purchase a Lucky Links ticket, go to a vending machine or any counter where Lottery is sold to ask the clerk for a ticket.

How to Choose Your Numbers:

This game is Quick Pick only. Eight numbers from one to twenty-two (1 -22) will be randomly generated for you.

Each play costs $1 and gives you a chance to win up to $25,000!

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings, and you also have the option to choose an add-on to increase your prize.

Then, your ticket will print with your Quick Pick numbers on it placed in a 3x3 grid with the center space “Free”. Each play prints on a separate ticket.

 

INCREASE YOUR PRIZES WITH SUPER BONUS

When you play Lucky Links you can add on Super Bonus for $1.

Adding Super Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your prize by 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, or 5X. At the very end of the drawing, a multiplier will be selected and will apply to any Lucky Links prize you win in that drawing.

 

HOW TO WIN

During the hourly drawing*, eight winning numbers** will be selected. Form any two or more lines in horizontal, vertical, or diagonal directions to win a prize***.

Examples:

Note: A play that forms 7 lines automatically forms 8 lines.

 

HOW TO CHECK WINNING NUMBERS

You can watch the hourly drawings on the Players Club app or online at ArizonaLottery.com.

You can also check your tickets by scanning them on the Players Club app or a ticket checker at an Arizona Lottery retailer.

 

ABOUT WINNING
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

LUCKY LINKS FAQS
WHAT ARE THE ODDS OF WINNING LUCKY LINKS?

Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 8.4

WHEN ARE LUCKY LINKS DRAWINGS HELD?

Drawings are held daily every 60 minutes. The first draw of the day is at 5:00 AM Arizona time and the last draw is at 11:00 PM Arizona time.

HOW OFTEN CAN I PLAY MY NUMBERS?

You can play for up to 15 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or select the Multi Draw box on the vending machine.

HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO CLAIM A LUCKY LINKS PRIZE?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

WHAT HAPPENS IF MULTIPLE PEOPLE WIN THE MAXIMUM PRIZE?

The players will share the prize in equal amounts.***

WHERE DO I FIND THE DRAW ID?

Draw IDs appear on each Quick Draw ticket purchased in the bottom right-hand corner. If you purchased a ticket for more than one drawing, a range of Draw IDs will be included on the ticket. For Example: DRAW ID 10001 or, DRAW ID 10001 THRU DRAW ID 10015

 

DISCLAIMERS

*Lucky Links can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 5:00 AM Arizona time. Players have until 11:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase Lucky Links tickets. The last drawing for Lucky Links will be at 11:00 PM Arizona time.

**Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

***Prizes would be pari-mutuel when the total prize for forming 7-8 lines with 5X multiplier drawn is above $125,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each $1.00 played. The prize amount per share is $125,000 divided by total winning wagers. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the wager amount.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

WHAT IS MEGA MILLIONS?

Mega Millions is a draw game where the goal is to match your numbers, with the winning numbers selected in the drawing to win cash prizes. There are nine ways to win!

Ticket Price: $5

Drawings: Tuesday and Friday

 

HOW TO PURCHASE TICKETS AND PLAY

How to Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer. Mega Millions tickets cost $5 per game and are available for purchase at the counter of Arizona Lottery Retailers and at Arizona Lottery vending machines. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

How to Choose Your Numbers

There are three ways to choose your numbers:

To let the computer select the numbers for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.

To choose your own numbers, fill out a selection slip or tell the cashier which six numbers you would like to select:

Five white balls (1 – 70)
One Mega Ball number (1 – 24)

You can also choose your own numbers for just the white balls or just the Mega Ball number, and use Quick Pick for the other number(s).

How to Check the Winning Numbers**

You can find the winning numbers online, or you can check your tickets by using a ticket scanner at an Arizona Lottery retailer or by calling the Winning Numbers Hotline:

Phoenix: 480.829.7425
Tucson: 520.325.9141
All Other Areas: 800.499.3798

ABOUT WINNING

How to Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

Jackpot Payment Options

If you win the jackpot, you have 60 days to choose a payment option:

30-year annuity
Lump-sum cash payment - which will be approximately half the amount of the announced jackpot

If you do not select cash or annuity within the 60 days, your prize will be paid as an annuity.

 

MEGA MILLIONS FAQS

What are the odds of winning Mega Millions?

The overall odds of winning a cash prize are approximately 1 in 23.07.

When are Mega Millions drawings held?

Drawings are held Tuesday and Friday evenings.

What does “Results Pending” mean in the “Next Estimated Jackpot” section?

When the website displays “Results Pending” for Powerball or Mega Millions draws, it means the Arizona Lottery is awaiting information from the Multi-State Lottery Association on if the jackpot has been increased or if anyone has won the jackpot. Once the Arizona Lottery receives this information, the next estimated jackpot amount will be displayed.

How often can I play my numbers?

You can play your numbers for up to 10 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark the Multi Draw box on your selection slip.

How long do I have to claim a prize?

For draw game tickets, 180 days from the date of the draw. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

What happens if multiple people win the jackpot?

The players will share the jackpot in equal amounts.

WHAT IS PICK 3?

Pick 3 is a draw game where you try to pick one or two sets of three-digit numbers that match the winning numbers drawn to win a prize.

Ticket Price: $1

Drawings: Midday and Evening, Monday through Sunday

 

WHAT IS A PLAY TYPE?

The Play Type is the way you choose to play your numbers and determines the amount you can win. When purchasing a ticket, you will choose your numbers first then choose your Play Type.

You can choose from different Play Types:

Straight – Select any three numbers. They must match the winning numbers in exact order to win.
Box 3-Way – Two of the three numbers you select must be the same. Your numbers can match the winning numbers in any order to win.
Box 6-Way – All three of the numbers you select must be different. Your numbers can match the winning numbers in any order to win.
Straight/Box – Select any three numbers. They can match in exact order or any order to win but an exact match has a higher prize.
Front Pair – Select any three numbers. Your first two numbers must match the winning numbers in exact order to win.
Back Pair – Select any three numbers. Your last two numbers must match the winning numbers in exact order to win.

HOW TO PURCHASE TICKETS AND PLAY

How to Purchase a Ticket
Find an Arizona Lottery retailer. Pick 3 tickets cost $1 per game (1-play and 2-play) and are available for purchase at the counter of Arizona Lottery retailers and at Arizona Lottery vending machines. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

How to Choose Your Numbers

There are two ways to choose numbers:

To let the computer select the numbers for you, choose a Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want a Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.

To choose your own numbers, fill out a selection slip or tell the cashier. Pick one or two sets of three-digit numbers (000 – 999).

How to Choose Your Play Type

Fill out the selection slip or tell the cashier which one of the six play types you would like to play (Straight, Box 3-Way, Box 6-Way, Straight/Box, Front Pair or Back Pair).

How to Check the Winning Numbers

You can find the winning numbers online, at an Arizona Lottery retailer or by calling the Winning Numbers Hotline:

Phoenix: 480.829.7425
Tucson: 520.325.9141
All Other Areas: 800.499.3798

How to Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

PICK 3 FAQS

What are the odds of winning Pick 3?

It depends on the Play Type you select. View the complete list of odds.

When are Pick 3 drawings held?

Drawings are held twice a day, midday and evening, Monday through Sunday.

How often can I play my numbers?

You can play your numbers for up to 12 consecutive drawings on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark the Number of Draws box on your selection slip.

How long do I have to claim a prize?

For draw game tickets, 180 days from the date of the draw. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

 

*Sales stop for midday draws at 11:59 AM Arizona time, and for evening draws at 6:59 PM Arizona time.

**Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

On occasion, certain Pick 3 and Pick 4 sets of numbers may "sell out" and cannot be purchased. Unlike jackpot games (e.g., Powerball, Mega Millions) where winners share the top prize, daily games pay out an established fixed prize to every single winning ticket. To ensure the Arizona Lottery can fulfill its prize obligations, a maximum sales limit is established for every set of numbers. For each daily draw for the Pick 3 and Pick 4, once a specific set of numbers reaches its sales limit, no further tickets for that specific set of numbers will be sold for that day's drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

WHAT IS PICK 4?

Pick 4 is a draw game where you try to pick one or two sets of four-digit numbers that match the winning numbers drawn to win a prize.

Ticket Price: $1

Drawings: Twice a day, midday and evening, Monday through Sunday

 

WHAT IS A PLAY TYPE?

Player Tip – In order to select a

Front Pair – Select any four numbers. The first two numbers selected match the winning numbers in the exact order.
Middle Pair – Select any four numbers. The middle two numbers selected match the winning numbers in the exact order.
Back Pair – Select any four numbers. The last two numbers match the winning numbers in the exact order.

WHAT IS POWERBALL?

Powerball is a draw game where the goal is to match your numbers with the winning numbers selected in the drawing. There are nine different ways to win!

Ticket Price: $2

Drawings: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday

 

WHAT IS POWER PLAY?

Power Play multiplies your winnings*** by 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10**** times. Mark the Power Play box or ask the cashier for the Power Play option when you purchase your ticket. The Power Play number is randomly selected just after each Powerball drawing.

Additional Cost: $1 per game

Applies To: All prizes except the jackpot and Match 5 prize. Winning the Match 5 prize (all 5 white balls) pays $2 million regardless of the multiplier number drawn. Power Play does not apply to Double Play prizes.

 

WHAT IS DOUBLE PLAY?

Double Play offers another chance to win a prize up to $10,000,000 using the same Powerball numbers you selected. After the Powerball drawing, an additional set of five numbers from 1 - 69 and one number from 1 - 26 are drawn. Mark the Double Play box or ask the cashier for the Double Play option when you purchase your ticket.

Additional Cost: $1 per game


HOW TO PURCHASE TICKETS AND PLAY

How to Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer. Powerball tickets cost $2 per game and are available for purchase* at the counter of Arizona Lottery retailers and at Arizona Lottery vending machines. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

How to Choose Your Numbers

There are three ways to choose your numbers.

To let the computer select the numbers for you, choose Quick Pick on the vending machine or tell the cashier you want Quick Pick at the time of your purchase.

To choose your own numbers, fill out a selection slip or tell the cashier which six numbers you would like to select:

5 white numbers (1 – 69)
1 Powerball number (1 – 26)

You can also choose your own numbers for just the white numbers or just the red Powerball number, and use Quick Pick for the other number(s).

Multiply Your Winnings

When purchasing a ticket, you can add on Power Play for just an additional $1 per game to multiply your winnings*** by 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10**** times. Tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark it on your selection slip. Just after the Powerball drawing, a Power Play number will be selected, and your winnings will be multiplied by that amount!
